## Checklist

- [ ] `yarn release:check` passes locally
- [ ] Tests added or updated for behavior changes
- [ ] `dist/` rebuilt with `yarn build` and committed
- [ ] `src/razorbox.d.ts` and README updated if the public API changed
- [ ] Commit subjects use a prefix (`[FEATURE]`, `[BUGFIX]`, `[TASK]`, `[DOCS]`, `[SECURITY]`, `[!!!]`); they become the changelog
- [ ] Keyboard and screen reader behavior checked for UI changes
